content.comment_body: The latest versions of [product_name] apps are now available for iOS and Android. New features include configurable pushbuttons, demo connection for initial testing, connection and tag import using Excel, onboarding guide, built-in user manual, enhanced button arrangement that allows up to 4 buttons side-by-side, and improved output field layout supporting up to 4 output fields. These updates are available for both iOS and Android platforms.

analysis.insight_summary: An announcement highlights the release of new versions of [product_name] apps for iOS and Android, featuring usability improvements and workflow enhancements such as Excel-based tag import and more flexible controls. Updates like demo connection and integrated documentation signal a push for easier onboarding and more accessible testing tools. The information is strictly informative, without discussion about user experience or issues.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate more customization in controls, simplified connection setup, straightforward documentation access, and efficient data import and app testing workflows.
pain_keywords: lack of immediate access to help
